climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Malbec sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A Bergerac appellation in South West France, for red wine from the hills northeast of Bergerac, made from Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon and Cot.
